22712-lost-1898.title: Lost 1898
22712-lost-1898.creator: Edward Bellamy
22712-lost-1898.description: A book by Edward Bellamy. uld leave Bonn to catch the requisite steamer. Had it been in November, nature at least would have sympathized; it was cruel that their autumn time of separation should fall in the spring, when the sky is full of bounteous promise and the earth of blissful trust.

40774-brooks-s-readers-third-year.title: Third Year
40774-brooks-s-readers-third-year.creator: Stratton D. Brooks
40774-brooks-s-readers-third-year.description: A book by Stratton D. Brooks. Did you ever hear of the Magic Windows? Those who look through them behold many strange and beautiful sights. If you will but make them your own, you may enter the fairyland of wonder and see all its rich treasures.

46515-the-blue-poetry-book-7th-ed.creator: Unknown

With 5 Coloured Plates and 45 other Illustrations. With a Portrait of Andrew Lang as Frontispiece,  12 Coloured Plates, and 18 other Illustrations. THE BOOK OF SAINTS AND HEROES. With 12 Coloured Plates and 18 other Illustrations.

arxiv-1410-0679.title: The Physics of Gamma-Ray Bursts & Relativistic Jets
arxiv-1410-0679.creator: Pawan Kumar, Bing Zhang
arxiv-1410-0679.description: Abstract We provide a comprehensive review of major developments in our understanding of gamma-ray bursts, with particular focus on the discoveries made within the last fifteen years when their true nature was uncovered. We describe the observational properties of photons from the radio to multi-GeV bands, both in the prompt emission and the afterglow phases.

arxiv-2108-00577.title: Logic-Consistency Text Generation from Semantic Parses
arxiv-2108-00577.creator: Chang Shu, Yusen Zhang, Xiangyu Dong, Peng Shi, Tao Yu, Rui Zhang
arxiv-2108-00577.description: Abstract Text generation from semantic parses is to generate textual descriptions for formal representation inputs such as logic forms and SQL queries. This is challenging due to two reasons: (1) the complex and intensive inner logic with the data scarcity constraint, (2) the lack of automatic evaluation metrics for logic consistency.

arxiv-2108-04692.title: Automated Audio Captioning using Transfer Learning and Reconstruction Latent Space Similarity Regularization
arxiv-2108-04692.creator: Andrew Koh, Xue Fuzhao, Chng Eng Siong
arxiv-2108-04692.description: Abstract In this paper, we examine the use of Transfer Learning using Pretrained Audio Neural Networks (PANNs) [ 1 ] , and propose an architecture that is able to better leverage the acoustic features provided by PANNs for the Automated Audio Captioning Task [ 2 ] . We also introduce a novel self-supervised objective, Reconstruction Latent Space Similarity Regularization (RLSSR).

arxiv-2201-13092.title: A detailed model of gene promoter dynamics reveals the entry into productive elongation to be a highly punctual process.
arxiv-2201-13092.creator: Jaroslav Albert jaroslav.albert@ronininstitute.org
arxiv-2201-13092.description: Abstract Gene transcription is a multistep stochastic process that involves thousands of reactions. The first set of these reactions, which happen near a gene promoter, are considered to be the most important in the context of stochastic noise and have been a focus of much research.

arxiv-2207-01134.title: Exact expressions for the partition function of the one-dimensional Ising model in the fixed- M M ensemble.
arxiv-2207-01134.creator: Daniel Dantchev, Joseph Rudnick
arxiv-2207-01134.description: Abstract We obtain exact closed-form expressions for the partition function of the one-dimensional Ising model in the fixed- M M ensemble, for three commonly-used boundary conditions: periodic, antiperiodic and Dirichlet. These expressions allow for the determination of fluctuation-induced forces in the canonical ensemble, which we term Helmholtz forces.

arxiv-2303-10876.title: EqMotion: Equivariant Multi-agent Motion Prediction with Invariant Interaction Reasoning
arxiv-2303-10876.creator: Chenxin Xu, Robby T. Tan, Yuhong Tan, Siheng Chen, Yu Guang Wang, Xinchao Wang, Yanfeng Wang
arxiv-2303-10876.description: Abstract Learning to predict agent motions with relationship reasoning is important for many applications. In motion prediction tasks, maintaining motion equivariance under Euclidean geometric transformations and invariance of agent interaction is a critical and fundamental principle. However, such equivariance and invariance properties are overlooked by most existing methods.

arxiv-2305-01586.title: An Alternative to WSSS? An Empirical Study of the Segment Anything Model (SAM) on Weakly-Supervised Semantic Segmentation Problems
arxiv-2305-01586.creator: Weixuan Sun, Zheyuan Liu, Yanhao Zhang, Yiran Zhong, Nick Barnes
arxiv-2305-01586.description: Abstract The Segment Anything Model (SAM) has demonstrated exceptional performance and versatility, making it a promising tool for various related tasks. In this report, we explore the application of SAM in Weakly-Supervised Semantic Segmentation (WSSS). Particularly, we adapt SAM as the pseudo-label generation pipeline given only the image-level class labels.

arxiv-2305-04695.title: Exploring departures from Schwarzschild black hole in f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) gravity Journal: Eur. Phys. J. C
arxiv-2305-04695.creator: Vittorio De Falco e1,addr1,addr2, Francesco Bajardi e2,addr1,addr2, Rocco D’Agostino e3,addr1,addr2, Micol Benetti e4,addr1,addr2, Salvatore Capozziello e5,addr1,addr2,addr3
arxiv-2305-04695.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Vittorio De Falco e1,addr1,addr2, Francesco Bajardi e2,addr1,addr2, Rocco D’Agostino e3,addr1,addr2, Micol Benetti e4,addr1,addr2, Salvatore Capozziello e5,addr1,addr2,addr3. Different astrophysical methods can be combined to detect possible deviations from General Relativity. In this work, we consider a class of f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) gravity models selected by the existence of Noether symmetries. In this framework, it is possible to determine a set of static and spherically symmetric black hole solutions, encompassing small departures from the Schwarzschild geometry.

arxiv-2411-18416.title: Probabilistic size-and-shape functional mixed models
arxiv-2411-18416.creator: Fangyi Wang, Karthik Bharath, Oksana Chkrebtii, Sebastian Kurtek
arxiv-2411-18416.description: Abstract The reliable recovery and uncertainty quantification of a fixed effect function μ \mu in a functional mixed model, for modelling population- and object-level variability in noisily observed functional data, is a notoriously challenging task: variations along the x x and y y axes are confounded with additive measurement error, and cannot in general be disentangled.

arxiv-2505-10810.title: MoCLIP: Motion-Aware Fine-Tuning and Distillation of CLIP for Human Motion Generation
arxiv-2505-10810.creator: Gabriel Maldonado, Armin Danesh Pazho, Ghazal Alinezhad Noghre, Vinit Katariya, Hamed Tabkhi
arxiv-2505-10810.description: Abstract Human motion generation is essential for fields such as animation, robotics, and virtual reality, requiring models that effectively capture motion dynamics from text descriptions. Existing approaches often rely on Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP)-based text encoders, but their training on text-image pairs constrains their ability to understand temporal and kinematic structures inherent in motion and motion generation.

arxiv-2509-00107.title: Self-organized learning emerges from coherent coupling of critical neurons
arxiv-2509-00107.creator: Chuanbo Liu, Jin Wang
arxiv-2509-00107.description: Abstract Deep artificial neural networks have surpassed human-level performance across a diverse array of complex learning tasks, establishing themselves as indispensable tools in both social applications and scientific research. Despite these advances, the underlying mechanisms of training in artificial neural networks remain elusive.

arxiv-2602-06707.title: Autoregressive Models for Knowledge Graph Generation
arxiv-2602-06707.creator: Thiviyan Thanapalasingam thiviyan.t@gmail.com, Antonis Vozikis a.vozikis@uva.nl, Peter Bloem p.bloem@vu.nl, Paul Groth p.t.groth@uva.nl
arxiv-2602-06707.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Thiviyan Thanapalasingam thiviyan.t@gmail.com, Antonis Vozikis a.vozikis@uva.nl, Peter Bloem p.bloem@vu.nl, Paul Groth p.t.groth@uva.nl. Knowledge Graph (KG) generation requires models to learn complex semantic dependencies between triples while maintaining domain validity constraints. Unlike link prediction, which scores triples independently, generative models must capture interdependencies across entire subgraphs to produce semantically coherent structures. We present ARK ( A uto- R egressive K nowledge Graph Generation), a family of autoregressive models that generate KGs by treating graphs as sequences of (head, relation, tail) triples.

As critical infrastructure modernizes toward increasingly software-d

pmc-11314623.title: The Effect of Carbon Nanofibers on the Mechanical Performance of Epoxy-Based Composites: A Review
pmc-11314623.creator: Paulo Santos, Abílio P Silva, Paulo N B Reis, Yizhuo Gu
pmc-11314623.description: This review is a fundamental tool for researchers and engineers involved in the design and optimization of fiber-reinforced composite materials. The aim is to provide a comprehensive analysis of the mechanical performance of composites with epoxy matrices reinforced with carbon nanofibers (CNFs).

pmc-11545234.title: Optimizing Treatment Strategies for Egfr-Mutated Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer Treated with Osimertinib: Real-World Outcomes and Insights
pmc-11545234.creator: Quentin Dominique Thomas, Nicolas Girard, Lise Bosquet, Sarah Cavaillon, Thomas Filleron, Siham Eltaief, Christos Chouaid, Hervé Lena, Didier Debieuvre, Maurice Perol, Xavier Quantin
pmc-11545234.description: Simple SummaryThis study examined the real-world effectiveness of osimertinib, a third-generation tyrosine kinase inhibitor, on EGFR-mutated non-small-cell lung cancer. Osimertinib has shown promising results in clinical trials, but this research study looked at how it performs in real-world settings, where patients may have different characteristics than those typically included in trials.

pmc-11556425.title: Pediatric Hodgkin Lymphoma in Low- and Middle-Income Countries (LMICs). A Narrative Review
pmc-11556425.creator: Maria Luisa Moleti, Anna Maria Testi, Salma Al-Hadad, Mazin Faisal Al-Jadiry, Robin Foà
pmc-11556425.description: Pediatric Hodgkin lymphoma (HL) is a curable disease for more than 90% of children and adolescents in high-income countries. However, similar results cannot be achieved, particularly for advanced disease, in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), where challenging socio-economic realities and the consequent scarcity of local resources heavily impact the treatment and patients’ outcome.

pmc-11650057.title: Transabdominal Preperitoneal (TAPP) Compared to Totally Extraperitoneal (TEP) for Primary Inguinal Hernia Repair in a Military Hospital: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-11650057.creator: Sunil Basukala, Oshan Shrestha, Suchit Thapa Chhetri, Niranjan Thapa, Samana Oli, Bipin K. Mehta, Nabin Pokhrel, Bishal Tiwari
pmc-11650057.description: BackgroundInguinal hernias are encountered commonly, but there is a lack of uniformity and standardization in repair techniques. There are a variety of repair methods, from open methods to laparoscopic approaches. The available laparoscopic techniques that exist for inguinal hernia repair are transabdominal preperitoneal (TAPP) repair and totally extraperitoneal (TEP) repair.

pmc-11710308.title: Platelet‐based therapies in neurodegeneration: Unlocking blood‐brain crosstalk
pmc-11710308.creator: Thierry Burnouf
pmc-11710308.description: Understanding the physiological connection between platelets and brain function reveals new paradigms in neurodegenerative disease treatment. Platelets, traditionally associated with hemostasis, but also sometimes regarded as a mirror of neurons in the blood circulation, also encompass a spectrum of neurobiological roles, including neuroinflammation modulation, neurogenesis, and synaptic remodeling.

pmc-12548858.title: Family support after a family member’s suicide: A qualitative exploration
pmc-12548858.creator: Franziska Marek, Nathalie Oexle, Sanja Batić Očovaj, Sanja Batić Očovaj, Sanja Batić Očovaj
pmc-12548858.description: Suicide bereavement presents unique challenges that shape how grief is experienced and supported within relational networks. Although family members often serve as a primary source of support, the interpersonal dynamics underlying such support remain understudied. This study explores how individuals bereaved by a family member’s suicide experience social support within the shared grief context of the family.

pmc-12808329.title: Biomass valorization using 3D-printed catalysts
pmc-12808329.creator: Sathiyamoorthy Murugesan, Vlad Andrei Neacșu, Minodora Maria Marin, Ionuț-Cristian Radu, Derniza-Elena Cozorici, Erika Blânzeanu, Cătălin Zaharia, Kelvin Adrian Sanoja-Lopez, Rafael Luque, Marian Nicolae Verziu
pmc-12808329.description: Catalytic biomass valorization into value-added chemicals is crucial to reduce reliance on fossil resources and mitigate environmental impacts. However, more than 90% of chemical manufacturing still relies on conventional catalysts, underscoring the need for sustainable alternatives. Three-dimensional (3D) printing offers unique opportunities to design catalysts with tailored geometries and pore architectures, enhancing mass transfer, active site accessibility, and reusability.

pmc-13196966.title: Antimicrobial resistance in Gram-negative bacteria from retail meat: Prevalence and public health implications
pmc-13196966.creator: Safia Arbab, Hanif Ullah, Weiwei Wang, Anwar Shahzad, Abdullah A. Aseeri, Fuad M. Alzahrani, Khalid J. Alzahrani, Khalaf F. Alsharif, Jiyu Zhang
pmc-13196966.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Retail meat is an important source of nutrition, but it may also serve as a reservoir of antimicrobial-resistant Gram-negative bacteria, posing a significant public health concern. This study investigated 123 retail meat samples collected from outlets in Sindh, Pakistan, including locally produced raw ground meat, imported raw ground meat, raw beef burgers, frozen chicken portions, and swabs from the outer surfaces of chicken carcasses, to identify Gram-negative bacteria and assess their antimicrobial susceptibility patterns. Gram-negative bacteria were recovered from all samples.
